method.name: milp_direct_integer
steps: Formulate as MILP: 3 integer variables (n_cows, n_sheep, n_chickens >= 0, integer)
Constraints: manure <= 800, n_chickens <= 50, n_cows >= 10, n_sheep >= 20, total <= 100
Declare all variables as HighsVarType.kInteger from start

method.name: milp_lp_relaxation_then_round
steps: Phase 1: solve LP relaxation with continuous variables
Phase 2: round integer variables to nearest integers respecting constraints
Phase 3: local search / repair to ensure all constraints satisfied
Use HiGHS highs API for Phase 1 solve
